title: Exploring the peroxidase-like activity of 4Fe–Ni–B nanoparticles for analytical sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7535-7545
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00149H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Si-Hua Deng, Ying-Zhao Ma, Yi-Fan Han, Qi Zhou, Wen-Sheng Fu
Metal boride nanoenzymes are first reported to exhibit peroxidase-like activity. Their catalytic mechanisms were clarified via DFT. This work broadens their potential applications while advancing 2D metal boride development.
